title: precheck skips a bug's repro, so a bug whose repro is the intake --status of a time-windowed detector gets no warning
goal: Found in the SP-vmxdxtru review: ST-tnbnmec6's goal says precheck warns of a committed item whose check or repro is backlog.py intake --status FP of a time-windowed detector, but bl_land.precheck_rows reads only an item's checks, never a bug's repro; the trailers detector files a bug whose repro is intake --status FP, which is exactly the case BG-jbn2z4mt hit. precheck runs a bug's repro as it runs checks and warns of it the same way; tools.md and backlog.md say so.

run: import subprocess,sys,tempfile,os;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_intake;live=os.getcwd();t=tempfile.mkdtemp();subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',t],check=True);os.makedirs(t+'/kb/_self/backlog');b=[sys.executable,live+'/_tools/backlog.py','--root',t];R=lambda *a:subprocess.run(b+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=t).stdout;sp=R('new','sprint','--title','S').split()[2];fp=bl_intake.fingerprint('trailers',bl_intake.WHOLE_KEY);i=R('new','bug','--title','B','--sprint',sp,'--goal','g','--severity','S3','--repro','python3 _tools/backlog.py intake --status '+fp).split()[2];o=R('precheck',sp);print(i,o);sys.exit(0 if any(i in l and '7 days' in l for l in o.splitlines()) else 1)

notes: Premise: its repro. Run at planning on 2026-10-10: exit 1, precheck prints 'checks=0 passing=0' for a bug whose repro is the trailers intake --status. Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 10 of 13).
